events.content:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.
I'll look at the workspace first, then build a small book tracker that stores books in a JSON file and supports shareable book links.
The repo is almost empty, so I'll add a small Node server with JSON storage and a plain page for the reading list.

events.content:
The reading list is a small Node app with no accounts. Books live in data/books.json and stay there after a restart.

Open it with npm start, then go to http://localhost:3000. The home page shows what you're currently reading and what you've finished. A form adds a book with title, author, and notes. Mark finished moves it to the finished list. Each title links to /book/<id>, which shows the title, author, and notes, and that URL is the link you can send someone.

npm test passed (4 tests). A live check of add, detail, finish, the share page, and the JSON file also passed.
